payload.title: next page button advances the results list
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByRole('button', { name: 'Next page' })
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: Superficially a timeout-shaped flake, but the results list was redesigned to infinite scroll and the 'Next page' button was removed entirely — not hidden, not slow to render, just gone. Both attempts report the identical not-found failure, with neither attempt showing a different symptom than the other — the signature of a UI redesign outrunning the test suite, not variance.
